category_title: Young children with persistent challenging behaviors and communication delays
scenario_title: Cleanup routine transition at childcare center
minimal_context: Kayden is at the childcare center during the routine transition to clean up toys and line up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is the one-minute warning signal before cleanup starts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues playing with the toys as the transition warning signal is given.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, time is up. Please clean up your toys and go line up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the toys on the floor and tries to quickly walk over to line up before the other children.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kayden, you need to come back and put your toys away in the bin first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the toys, throws them across the room to get out of cleaning up, and runs back to the line.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: This is the one-minute warning signal before cleanup starts.

STUDENT: (Continues playing with the toys as the transition warning signal is given.)

STUDENT: (Grabs the toys, throws them across the room to get out of cleaning up, and runs back to the line.)
